Independently recomputed Jacobian determinant x(3xy+4y^2+4z), first branch component B=b^2+a^3b-a^2c, second R=256 resultant_t(beta-b,gamma-c), its specialization R(0,b,c)=-256(b^3+c^2), and quartic discriminant -a^4 B R. Nonzero constant leading coefficient in c and irreducibility of b^3+c^2 justify R irreducible; coordinate w=c-ab makes B=b^2-a^2w, giving one Whitney pinch at origin. Restricted c=x^4+x^3+2x^2 at a=1,b=0 has three distinct simple critical values; its connected degree-four cover has transposition-generated S4 monodromy, hence global monodromy S4. Exact symbolic rechecks corroborate, not replace these geometric arguments.
